name: Fisher's Quality Products
background: Describes itself as family-owned; began with one line of cribs in 2010

intro.text: We started very small out of our home shop, manufacturing just one line of cribs in 2010.
intro.source: Fisher's Quality Products, from its profile on All American Wholesalers

story.source: Fisher's Quality Products, from its profile on All American Wholesalers

story.text: While working for a local woodshop for over 10 years, we noticed an increased demand for cribs coming into the shop.
story.source: Fisher's Quality Products, from its profile on All American Wholesalers

story.text: So, owner Joseph Fisher decided to start his own business … We started very small out of our home shop, manufacturing just one line of cribs in 2010. We have worked our way up to manufacturing a full line of convertible cribs, convertible changing tables, chests of drawers, and night stands.
story.source: Fisher's Quality Products, from its profile on All American Wholesalers

story.text: We know how difficult and expensive it can be to transition children from cribs, to toddler beds, to day beds, to full sized beds, so we make it easy.
Toddler Bed/Day Bed Conversion Kits include day bed frame, toddler bed rail, and hardware
Our Full Size Bed Conversion Kit includes bed rails, slats, and hardware

banner.alt: Six-drawer changing table with inlaid lines and bail pulls
